alert.once: You will get another notice when it is resolved.

agent_offline.headline: The server stopped reporting
agent_offline.advice: Check that the machine is powered on and connected to the internet.

backup_failed.headline: The backup failed
backup_failed.advice: Check the server's free disk space and run a manual backup.

disk_low.headline: The disk is almost full
disk_low.resolved: The disk has free space again
disk_low.advice: Free up space or enlarge the disk: once it is full, Odoo stops working.

environment_down.headline: Production is not running
environment_down.advice: Check the environment's logs and restart it from the panel.

agent_outdated.headline: The agent needs an update
agent_outdated.resolved: The agent is up to date
agent_outdated.advice: Press “Update now” on the server's page. Until then, deploys and backups are not possible.

agent_version_unknown.headline: The agent does not report its version
agent_version_unknown.resolved: The agent reports its version again
agent_version_unknown.advice: Its updates cannot be checked until it does. Press “Update now” on the server's page, or install the agent again.

update_failed.headline: The agent update failed
update_failed.advice: The server went back to the previous version on its own and keeps running. Try again with “Update now”.

platform_step_failed.headline: A component could not be updated
platform_step_failed.advice: It went back to its previous version on its own and keeps running. It will be retried with the next version.

platform_behind.headline: The server has not updated for days
platform_behind.resolved: The server is up to date
platform_behind.advice: Check that automatic updates are on and that the disk has free space.

backup_not_offsite.headline: Production has no backup off the server
backup_not_offsite.resolved: Production has a backup off the server again
backup_not_offsite.advice: If the server is lost, the data is lost. Check the nightly backup.

backup_suspicious.headline: The latest backup is much smaller than the previous one
backup_suspicious.resolved: Backups are a normal size again
backup_suspicious.advice: Check that the environment's data is still there. Earlier backups are kept.

backup_growing.headline: Backups are growing faster than usual
backup_growing.advice: Check the size of the database and the list of backups.

restore_test_failed.headline: The test restore failed
restore_test_failed.advice: Run a manual backup, and do not count on restoring the latest one until a test passes.

details.update_failed: Could not move to {version} · still on {current}
details.backup_growing: From {from_gb} GB to {to_gb} GB in a week

reasons.no_room: not enough disk space for the test
reasons.nothing: there was no backup to test
reasons.connection: could not connect to the database
reasons.unanswered: the server did not finish the test

billing.nothing_deleted: Nothing you have is deleted over a pending payment.

card_refused.subject: We could not charge your subscription
card_refused.change: You can change the card from billing.

plan_ended.subject: Your plan ended for lack of payment
plan_ended.detail: Your projects keep running on your servers. The platform keeps working on the one you keep on the free plan; the rest can be viewed, their backups downloaded or deleted. Subscribe again from billing whenever you want.

plan_cancelled.subject: Your plan ended as you asked
plan_cancelled.detail: The period you paid for is over and the subscription was not renewed. Your projects keep running on your servers. The platform keeps working on the one you keep on the free plan; the rest can be viewed, their backups downloaded or deleted. Subscribe again from billing whenever you want.

copies_ending.subject: Your off-site backups will be deleted soon
copies_ending.detail: Your plan ended and the backups kept off your servers will be deleted on {date}. Download them before if you need them, or reactivate the plan to keep them.

copies_deleted.subject: Your off-site backups were deleted
copies_deleted.detail: Ninety days passed since your plan ended. The backups on your own servers are untouched.

declines.issuer_not_available: the bank is not available right now
declines.contact_issuer: the bank asks you to contact it
declines.authentication_required: the bank asked to confirm the charge

invitation.headline: Confirm that you want to receive alerts
invitation.detail: You were added to receive the alerts of {org}: servers without signal, failed backups, full disks and other problems.
invitation.note: If you did not expect this email, ignore it: nothing is sent without confirmation.

test.headline: Test email
test.detail: The alerts of {org} reach this address.
